2608.03744.title: Agents Catching Agents: Shortcut Cascades and Benchmark Gaming in Clinical Multi-Agent Systems
2608.03744.paper_summary: Clinical decision support is moving toward committees of language-model agents deliberating on a shared workspace. We ask whether such committees can be gamed by shortcuts, cues a benchmark rewards but a clinician would ignore. Across seven cohorts on six public datasets spanning text (MedQA-USMLE, MedMCQA, MIMIC-CXR reports), imaging (NIH ChestX-ray14, MIMIC-CXR-JPG, CheXpert) and tabular ICU records (SUPPORT2), Gemini committees resist these cues in isolation (flip 5-16%), yet a socially plausible shortcut spreads: when two peers assert the same wrong answer, the holdout under test adopts it in 38% of cases, as does a false "pre-screen" system flag, on both capability tiers. Of three oversight agents, a gate cannot separate adoption from honest agreement (false-positive rate 100%); a same-lineage judge reading only the transcript flags adoption on text (precision 100%, recall 93%) but collapses onto the gate in imaging; a referee that privately re-queries the holdout transfers to imaging (77-88% precision, 13-21% false-positive rate). Tripling a cue's visual salience does not move contagion, whereas a second peer voice raises it by half again. Gaming a hidden rubric is near-silent: only 1/10 text and 1/134 imaging drifters name the rubric they moved toward. What games a committee is social plausibility, and only a referee independent of self-report catches it. Code: https://github.com/criticaldata/benchmaxxing
2608.03744.paper_summary_zh: 臨床決策支持正朝向由語言模型代理組成的委員會在共享工作空間中進行討論。我們詢問這樣的委員會是否會被捷徑所操控，這些捷徑是基準獎勵的提示，但臨床醫生會忽略。跨越七個群體在六個公共數據集上的研究，涵蓋文本（MedQA-USMLE、MedMCQA、MIMIC-CXR報告）、影像（NIH ChestX-ray14、MIMIC-CXR-JPG、CheXpert）和表格ICU記錄（SUPPORT2），Gemini委員會在孤立情況下抵抗這些提示（翻轉5-16%），然而一種社會上可行的捷徑卻在擴散：當兩位同行聲稱相同的錯誤答案時，測試中的持有者在38%的情況下採納它，虛假的“預篩選”系統標記也是如此，在兩個能力層級上。三個監督代理中，一個閘門無法將採納與誠實協議分開（假陽性率100%）；一位同源法官僅閱讀逐字稿時，對文本的採納標記（精確度100%，召回率93%），但在影像中崩潰；一位私下重新查詢持有者的裁判轉移到影像（精確度77-88%，假陽性率13-21%）。將提示的視覺顯著性三倍化並未促進傳播，而第二位同行的聲音則將其提高了一半。操控隱藏標準幾乎是無聲的：只有1/10的文本和1/134的影像漂移者提到他們所朝向的標準。操控委員會的因素是社會可行性，只有一位獨立於自我報告的裁判能夠捕捉到它。代碼：https://github.com/criticaldata/benchmaxxing
